notes: calls: the real CanvasPainter + TextRenderer driven by `script` (RecordingPainter format) against a mock context; property assignments are ["set", prop, value], images by label (atlas:<font>, tint:<font>:<colour>, img<n>).
commands: the mock context's browser-semantics interpretation (see tools/golden/mockContext2d.ts for the flat format).
tints: offscreen tinted atlases in creation order with their own context calls.
